name: Wan Jie
current_role: Chairman, Artron Art Group (雅昌文化集团), Shenzhen
profile: Beijing-born (1962) founder-chairman of Artron, set up in Shenzhen in 1993 as a high-end art printer. He expanded it into China's largest art-data and online art portal (artron.net) with bases in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen. A long-time CPPCC National Committee member, he also served as a vice-president of the Palace Museum Academy.
interesting_fact: Artron grew from fine-art book printing into a digital art database business; in 2022 Wan used his CPPCC proposals to push metaverse and digital-culture infrastructure.
deep_cut_fact: At the 2014 'Two Sessions' he proposed a national copyright-registration system for Chinese calligraphy and paintings to clean up forgery in the art market.

public_contacts.value: help@artron.net (general Artron portal helpdesk, not personal)

notes: Best route is via Artron Group corporate channels; little English-language coverage. Industry listed as Print but now primarily art data/culture.
